data.report: November 25, 2026 | 7:01 AM Granite Chief, Mountain Meadow, Subway, and Big Carpet have been added to the schedule for this morning, for a total of 14 open lifts. Mostly cloudy through mid morning, gradually becoming partly sunny, with a mid-mountain high near 41. Light southwest wind around 5 mph. If you have been out the last few days, you know the skiing and riding has been great. Chalky snow can be found in spots, with groomers offering top-to-bottom turns across the mountain. IF you are willing to hike, there may be fresh turns waiting for you. If that's not your thing, Belmont Park is growing in front of our eyes, with the Terrain Parks crew adding exciting new features wherever possible. Safety reminder: Early season conditions exist. Snow coverage and grooming can vary, and marked and unmarked hazards may exist. Stay alert for rocks, trees, open creeks, and other obstacles. There is no groomed terrain off Siberia Express. With the current snowpack looking promising, Mountain Operations is anticipating additional terrain expansion as conditions allow. As terrain expands, please respect ropes, boundaries, and signage. Please stay out of closed terrain and wait for Patrol to officially open new areas. For more details on what could be opening next, check out our latest Operations Blog . See you out there! -Atticus For real-time information at your fingertips, download the Ikon Pass App for updates on lift status, events, weather, and more.
